plan.name: Show Codex thinking tokens when turns finish
plan.summary: Make each Codex live card use the sum of usage.reasoning_output_tokens reported by its completed turns, replacing text-length estimates when the first count arrives and counting each completed transcript line once, including an explicit zero. Expose thinkingExact in the live JSON so the card's thinking statistic and total legend show reported totals as full integers without an approximation sign; before any report retain existing estimates, and during later turns retain the last reported sum while showing the current activity instead of the previous turn's finished state. Keep reasoning items as timed thinking stretches with their existing estimates, keep Claude Code's streaming counts unchanged, and publish no agent words or reasoning text. Update the Codex live-view bullet in SPEC.md and explain this behavior in README.md, retaining the relevant D-0051, D-0116 and D-0136 citations as D-0122 requires. The exact-count policy is not yet recorded in the decision journal: whoever merges must record a two-way decision refining D-0136 and add its SPEC citation, since this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestLiveCodexReportsCompletedTurnThinking
tests.says: A Codex run with no reasoning items says thinking before usage arrives, then publishes the exact sum of completed turns, once per whole transcript line, and retains it across refreshes and after the step ends.

tests.name: TestLiveCodexUsageReplacesEstimatesAndKeepsThinkingStretches
tests.says: Reported Codex usage, including zero, replaces estimates without removing timed thinking stretches or exposing text; later reasoning items do not inflate the completed-turn total, and older transcripts without reasoning usage keep estimates.

tests.name: TestLiveThinkingCountsStayWithTheirAgentRun
tests.says: Concurrent Codex and Claude Code cards keep separate counts: Codex uses exact completed-turn usage, Claude Code keeps accumulating streamed estimates through completion, and a replaced Codex transcript starts fresh.
